win_system.notes:
WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 You win if matching symbols appear along one of the following predefined lines on adjacent reels from left to right, starting with the leftmost reel. The number of possible lines in this game is 14. Please consult the paytable for the number of each symbol

wilds.name: WILD REELS
wilds.behavior:
Wild Reels can land on any reel with a random multiplier with one of the following values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x.

 Wild Reels can’t land naturally in the Bonus games. They need to be unlocked by the Progress Ladder.

 If more than one Wild Reels are part of the same winning combination, their multipliers are added together before being applied to the win.

wilds.name: PROGRESS LADDER
wilds.behavior: The Progress Ladder is only available in Bonus games. It has 6 levels, each completed by collecting 3 Bonus scatter symbols. Completing each level grants one sticky Wild Reel and 1-3 additional free spins.

wilds.name: GO BANANAS
wilds.behavior:
Trigger the Go Bananas bonus with 10 free spins by landing 3 Bonus scatter symbols at the same time in the base game.

 Wild Reels only land when awarded by the Progress Ladder, and are sticky throughout the whole bonus round. Completing each level on the Progress Ladder awards a new sticky Wild Reel and 1-3 additional free spins.

wilds.name: BANANA PLANTATION
wilds.behavior:
Trigger the Banana Plantation bonus with 10 free spins by landing 4 Bonus symbols at the same time in the base game.

 This bonus game follows the same rules as Go Bananas bonus, but you start with Level 1 completed on the Progress Ladder, awarding a sticky Wild Reel from the start.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

wilds.name: WILD SYMBOL
wilds.behavior: The Wild symbol substitutes for all symbols in the paytable.

ABOUT THE GAME

 Go Bananas on Banana Farm! This 6‑reel, 4‑row game with payline wins sprouts Banana tree Wild Reels that lock entire reels sticky for jungle‑sized wins. Collect Bonus scatter symbols to climb the six‑tier Progress Ladder—each rung guarantees an extra sticky Wild Reel and awards 1–3 additional free spins for peel‑powered payouts!

 The max win in this game is 25 000x your bet and can be achieved all game modes.
